answer: A cloned identity cannot open a clearing window until it finishes a one-shot clerking trial at desk R-14. The applicant posts 22.8 POA and is handed spool T-40. Within 27 minutes they must stretch a 2.1 m thread across the desk's 8 cm notch, sign ledger slip LS-704 with quill Q-9 whose nib width is 0.7 mm, then press opal cabochon OC-33 so its 8.4 mm facet serial matches the slip in one photograph. A reused spool, a nib off by more than 0.05 mm, or a second trial from the same cluster burns the 22.8 POA and bars the address for five epochs. Two clerks recompute the facet hash and spool id.
